name: prompt-enhancer
description: '== <text>' or /grammar: checks only your grammar with one small Haiku call, puts the corrected text in an empty prompt box and shows what changed; nothing is sent to Claude. Switch it off in /config. Also ships two skills you call by name: /prompt-enhancer:enhance turns a request into one deeper prompt (with panel or grill), and /prompt-enhancer:goal-draft drafts a /goal or /loop. They replace the ++ modes removed in 0.14.0.

grammar.title: Grammar check (== and /grammar)
grammar.description: on: '== <text>' and /grammar check only your grammar with one small Haiku call (about 1.4K tokens), and never send your text to Claude. off: '==' is sent to Claude as you typed it, and this mod makes no model call at all.
